answer: Charge every new agent a small refundable stake, locked in escrow and released only after a history of honest work. A sybil farmer spinning up a nebula of fake identities must fund each one, so attack cost scales linearly with size while honest agents pay almost nothing. Reputation tracks the delta between staked and returned funds: identities caught cheating lose their stake and sink to the nadir of the trust ranking, where they earn nothing. Forging thousands of accounts stops being free and becomes a losing business.
